murals.name: 碑间折桌
murals.text: Scene: the floor of a vast dark underground level, flat dry stone under a thin creeping mist. Out of the blackness stand rows upon rows of chest-high boundary stones, half white stone and half black obsidian, set close into the dark. From the lower left one straight beam of white light cuts between the rows and stops, centre-low, on a small low folding table between two stones, an iron pot in its middle as if just laid. A strip of grey cloth is tied knee-high round the nearer stone, and more strips go on, one on each stone, into the dark. At the lamp stand four small figures: a thin young man in a deep teal short coat with brass buttons, dark blue hair loosely tied, holding up a lamp in a polished brass bowl; a barefoot young man in a worn grey coat with a coil of knotted rope; a young tiefling woman with two short straight horns and a misty-blue braid; a little halfling girl with honey-coloured curls tied in white cloth, a big medicine box on her back, a small candle lamp at her waist. Behind them one rope hangs down out of the darkness above.
murals.light: One narrow beam of cold white light from the brass lamp and the small warm flame of the candle lamp; everything else sinks into deep blue-black.
murals.note: 画的是寻人三幕下旬三日（第199到202行）：林纳斯的长灯放到底下，盖子一开光是一束，扫过一排一排白一面黑一面的碑，停在西边一百二十来步两块碑当中那张矮桌上，锅坐在桌当中，像有人刚摆好；桌边的碑上齐膝拴着巴纳比袍子下摆的布条，一块碑一根往西拴进黑里（第202、204行）。四个人是举长灯的林纳斯、本特、卡雅、巴纳比的侄女莫莉（十七岁，只提灯）。上头垂下来的是绞盘放下来的二百臂的绳（第199、200行），绞盘没画。拿不准：钩子说的是本特第三回下口子、石头扔下去响了那一下（第166行），那个画面是一个人吊在黑里扔石头，读不出寻人，所以挑了找着桌子这一下；桌上那截烧到底的白蜡烛根太小，没写。

murals.line: 探井的年月·第一次大迷宫潮
murals.name: 坡顶裂碑
murals.text: Scene: the seventh evening of a siege on the south rim of a vast spiral pit in open farmland. On the right the pit falls away in rings of terraces veined with glowing dark-red crystal; a long collapsed slope climbs from them to a crest. Down the slope a tide of shapeless creatures sinks back into the pit like an ebbing wave, layer behind layer, leaving grey ash. Centre-low on the crest stands a tall boundary stone, white on one face and black obsidian on the other, split from top to foot but still upright. Beside it stands one tall pale-skinned tiefling man, dark red hair in a long tail, two short horns angled back, an old copper ring on one horn, grey cloak, worn leather, a broad longsword lowered in one hand, the other resting on the cracked stone; dark map-like markings on his neck and arm glow faint gold. Around him the other defenders sit exhausted, among them a broad horned man with a long stone hammer and a tall archer woman with a pale gold braid. Behind the crest, a small shelter with a brass lamp at its door. Far behind, tiny people crowd the white rampart's battlements.
murals.light: Pale low evening light from the left over the ash and the slope; the only warm notes are the dark-red glow in the pit walls, the lamp at the shelter and the brief gold glow along the man's markings; the shadows are slate blue.
murals.note: 画的是第一次大迷宫潮二幕第七天傍晚（第524、525行）：太阳偏西，口子里的黑一点一点往下沉，坡顶上的人坐的坐、躺的躺，站着的只剩吉迪恩，一只手按在裂了的界碑上，身上那片墨色的纹从颈侧亮到手背，西门墙头上挤满了人喊守井的，他在那一阵凝了名。界碑第六天叫震裂、从碑顶裂到碑脚没倒（第523行）。坐着歇的是塔隆和格蕾琴（第519、521行上的坡顶），坡顶后头莫莉那顶棚子和门口的铜车灯照第509、522行。吉迪恩的样子照他的旅伴条（第587、590行）。拿不准：躺着的人一律写成坐着歇，免得像死人；挑的是潮退、凝名那一下，不是潮最凶的那几天；钩子那一句井口有人守着呢是第一天抱孩子的妇人说的（第518行），画面上写不进去。

murals.name: 冠与印
murals.text: Scene: seen from above and to one side, the deep passage of a ruined gate through an immense white stone wall; the middle of its roof has fallen in and daylight drops through. Along the passage stands one long table of two old wooden doors laid end to end on four iron legs; at its two ends sit two women facing each other. On the right, a woman in a white-gold and old-copper dress uniform, deep gold-brown hair pinned up, a rope-hilted old sword at her hip; a plain low crown rests on the papers before her. On the left, a woman in a long dark coat, long grey-silver hair bound with a dark red ornament; her iron gauntlet, just pulled off, lies by her hand, and a heavy copper seal pins a corner of the document. Down the seam between the doors lie seven small seals, each glowing a different faint colour that shines down through the seam onto the iron legs. Seven plain-robed figures stand by them. A dozen small guards, white stones hung at their necks, line the walls, their shadows thrown tall. Past the left end, white blocks are heaped beside a blank standing stone.
murals.light: Pale daylight falling through the broken roof and the soft many-coloured glow of the seven seals sinking through the table's seam onto its iron legs, with small warm lamp flames at both ends of the passage; the walls fall into cool blue-grey.
murals.note: 画的是断门长桌三幕霜降月下旬三日（第873、874行）：索恩薇娅先报数，摘下王冠放在桌子东头那叠纸上，巴尔缇娜褪下右手的铁手套放在一边，拿山铜王印压住停战文书的西角，七个代行者把七枚圣印放在两扇门板对缝的地方，圣印的光从接缝间透下来，四条铁腿映着七重颜色，守桌人的影子一齐落到两边的墙上。东头放在画面右边、西头放在左边。桌子是两扇门板拼的、四条腿是断兵器熔的（第834、835行），门洞当中一段顶塌了看得见天（第822行），两个人的样子照第867、868行。拿不准：巴尔缇娜这一天穿什么源稿没写，只写了暗红的山铜发饰和铁手套，我写成深色长外套；七个代行者是人不是神，写成素色长袍、不带纹章；门洞里掉下来的白石一幕就清出去码在无字碑旁边了（第830行），桌子西头五六步是无字碑和那堆白石（第850行），照这个写在画面左头；镜头写成从塌了顶的那一截斜着往下看，好同时看得见桌子两头。

murals.line: 探井的年月·头一回下井
murals.name: 二十六步
murals.text: Scene: a vast flat plain deep underground, covered knee-deep in white mist lying level in every direction, blind pale fish gliding just under its surface. At the far edge rises a sheer rock face with the dark mouths of side passages along it. Centre-low, one mouth is gone: where it opened there is only blank wall now, and the mist swirls against its foot. A thin guide rope runs taut over the mist from the hands of a tall, broad man of dragon lineage, human-faced, with black hair and silver scales on his neck and shoulders, and vanishes into the base of the blank wall, pinched in the stone; beside it a thin line of grey ash runs straight under the wall. A tall knight in a faded white surcoat holds up a lamp before the wall, a kite shield with a blank white face on his arm. A tall red-haired tiefling presses one fist to the rock, dust sifting down. A young tiefling woman with two short straight horns crouches at the mist's edge, two fingers at her lips. Close behind them the rest of the party, four more small figures, stand together in the mist.
murals.light: Cold white light from the knight's raised lamp and a second lamp behind spreading flat over the mist; the rock face and the distance sink into deep blue-grey.
murals.note: 画的是头一回下井二幕中旬四日（第1225到1227行）：斯基普拴着引绳进岔道，一边撒灰一边数，卡雅看见雾往岔道口里倒灌，数到二十六停了，岔道口响了一声像翻一页纸，塞巴斯蒂安的灯照过去是一面墙，引绳卡在墙脚的石头里，灰线压在墙底下，兰诺斯攥着引绳拉不动，卡雅含着两根指头吹哨，吉迪恩一拳砸在墙上落下一层粉。斯基普不画，只画合上以后的墙和那根绳。第三层的雾和没有眼睛的白鱼照第1220行，兰诺斯的样子照人物头一回下井的另外两个那一条（第3217行），塞巴斯蒂安的白盾照他的旅伴条。拿不准：钩子说的是阿卡迪亚接着、本特在界碑脚下一个一个放九个人下去（第1202行），那一下的构图跟主画 k4 几乎一样，所以挑了岔道合上这一下，主会话要钩子那一下就换。

murals.line: 探井的年月·第三层的酒
murals.name: 桩头一杯
murals.text: Scene: night on a flat plain deep underground, knee-deep in white mist that runs off into darkness. Centre-low, on a slightly raised patch where the mist thins to the ankles, stands a small camp: a ring of wooden stakes, a tall pole in the middle with one burning lamp, and an oiled-cloth lean-to sheltering three wooden barrels on a rack, a row of wooden cups and a small money box. On top of the stake at the far side of the ring stands one full wooden cup. Beside that stake stands a very tall, broad half-orc with blue-grey skin, small lower tusks, a shaved head with one thin dark-green braid and a sleeveless leather vest, holding a long iron-capped carrying pole level in the gap of the ring. Under the lamp pole sits a slender young woman with ivory-white bobbed hair and bone-white skin, in a grey robe, an open book on her knees. Inside the ring others lie asleep: a man with straight black-tipped horns, a tall archer woman, a lanky boy beside a long hooked pole, a tiefling with two short dark horns. Beyond the stakes, a row of tall dim shadow-figures stands waiting in the mist.
murals.light: One warm lamp on the pole lighting the camp and the cup on the stake; the mist around glows faintly white and fades into deep blue-black.
murals.note: 画的是第三层的酒三幕那一夜（第1635、1637行）：阿托倒的头一杯，绍克说他丢了一桶不该喝，把杯子搁在桩圈正北那根桩头上，说大家醒了他再喝；后半夜雾里立起一排人高的黑影，他横着杠子守住桩口；朵薇坐在灯杆底下隔一阵念一遍营里的名字，别人在桩圈里躺下。棚子、三桶、木杯、钉在台边的钱匣照第1631行，桩圈和灯杆照第1594、1630行。躺着的是塔隆、格蕾琴、扬科、阿托。绍克、朵薇的样子照各人的旅伴条（第1857、1801行），绍克的皮色源稿写青灰，写成 blue-grey。拿不准：派活说明写 bone folk 是高个子，朵薇的旅伴条写的是个子不高、纤细，照她本人写，只写骨白的皮肤，额角那一小块刻了号的骨头人小看不见没写；扬科十六岁，画的是睡着，没有伤；黑影撞上来、黑灰越过木桩那一下不画，画的是它们还在雾里站着。

murals.name: 铃响七下
murals.text: Scene: noon on the north rim of a vast spiral pit, lined with a low stone balustrade hung with small plain wooden tags. Centre-low stands a heavy timber winch frame, one leg set at the foot of a tall boundary stone, half white, half black; its chain pinned with an iron bolt, an empty iron cage hangs still at the edge. From the frame one thin rope runs down into the pit, a small old bronze bell at its top end swinging. On a low stool beside the frame sits a lean tiefling man with two short glossy black horns and misty-blue curls under an oilcloth cap, his forehead pressed to the frame's leg. Beside him an old tiefling woman with short horns and a long pale-blue braid sits humming, and low white mist spreads from her over the rim. Two full cups of ale stand untouched on the frame's top beam. Below, the pit's spiral walls blaze with rings of dark-red crystal and a dark tide churns in the lower terraces. On the far rim, at the top of a long slope, one tiny cloaked figure stands beside a cracked boundary stone, holding the tide back.
murals.light: Dull grey daylight muffled by the mist on the rim, set against the fierce dark-red glow of the crystal rings in the pit below; the shadows are grey-blue.
murals.note: 画的是封井三幕上旬七日正午（第1959、1961、1962行）：六日天刚亮吉迪恩封了井，杜尔夫拿铁销把链子销死，嘉莉把刹车扳到底，笼子空着挂在井口（第1958行）；正午那一根通到井底的铃绳动了，铃响七下，阿托坐在本特坐过的矮凳上，额头贴着架腿，卡雅坐在旁边哼往下沉的调子，把北沿藏进雾里；曼蒂每天早上送一杯搁在架子上，阿托不喝，到七日正午是两杯；吉迪恩在南沿坡顶那块裂了的界碑旁边站着（第1961行）。铃是本特那卷四十个结的绳头上的旧铜铃（第1927行）。北沿的石栏、木牌、界碑和压在碑脚的绞盘架子照世道（第1929行）。拿不准：这一年卡雅一百二十二岁、看着六十上下（照她的旅伴条第340行，100年一百二十五岁看着六十上下），阿托一百零四岁，样子源稿只写到黑角、雾蓝的卷发、油布帽，没写老相，我没写他老；北沿裹在雾里还看不看得见对面坡顶，写成雾只铺在沿上、隔着井看得见。

notes: 头一回下井挑的是岔道合上（高潮），没挑钩子那一下（本特在界碑脚下一个一个放九个人下去，第1202行），那一下的构图跟主画 k4 几乎一样；要换请主会话定。
q1_d 和 q1_e 都在第三层齐膝的雾里，一幅在平地边上那一面合上的墙前，一幅在营里的灯下；嫌两幅太像，q1_d 可以换成第一层碑顶放火、白翎黑翎的箭停下那一下（第1208行）。
第一次大迷宫潮挑的是第七天傍晚潮往下退、吉迪恩一只手按着裂了的界碑、凝名的那一下，不是潮最凶的那几天。
卡雅的镰刀几幅都没写，弯刃怕画成月牙；巴尔缇娜、吉迪恩、卡雅、阿托的角都在人身上，人小，不会贴着天。
朵薇照她的旅伴条是个子不高的白骸，跟派活说明 bone folk 写的高个子不一样，照她本人写。
龙裔几幅都写成人脸、只身上几处有鳞，没用 dragonborn 这个词，怕画成龙头人。
